correctness.rationale: Backward equations on R\{0} for active/inactive gate with Poisson resets at a have bounded symmetric/antisymmetric modes with decay rates k=sqrt(r/D),h=sqrt((r+2gamma)/D). Active boundary data u_A(0+)=0,u_A(0-)=1; inactive value and derivative continuous; self-consistency at x=a gives U_+=(1-k/h+k^2 e^(-ah)/(h(h+k)))/4. Almost-sure absorption and bounded optional stopping establish uniqueness. Strict derivative signs in t=k/h,z=ah establish monotonicities and all singular limits. Independently verified boundary matching to 1e-15 and 36 monotonicity grids. A fixed gamma=0 inactive gate is not treated as the gamma->0 eventual-capture limit.
